name: smart-terminal
description: A VS Code-style workbench for running many Claude Code sessions at once, each on a different Claude account.
author: Viktor Karpyuk

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,magenta "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env SMART_TERMINAL_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.dist: npm run stamp && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.test: rm -rf .test-build && tsc src/state/layout.ts src/lib/preview.ts --outDir .test-build --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck && node test/layout.test.js && node --test test/transcript.test.js test/turn-state.test.js test/autopilot.test.js test/restore.test.js test/cli-env.test.js test/messaging.test.js test/git-graph.test.js test/session-analysis.test.js test/session-monitor.test.js test/advisor.test.js test/health-op.test.js test/session-brief.test.js test/history.test.js test/preview.test.js
